sources.title: How two suburban Taco Bell employees helped foil an alleged mass shooting plot
Chicago-area Hindu community shaken but resilient after alleged mass shooting plan was thwarted

en.title: Chicago authorities foil alleged mass shooting plot targeting Hindu community
en.dek: Two Taco Bell employees reported suspicious activity that led to the prevention of an alleged mass shooting plot against a Chicago-area Hindu community.
facts: Two Taco Bell employees reported suspicious activity that led to the prevention of an alleged mass shooting plot, according to NBC 5 Chicago.
The alleged plot targeted a Hindu community in the Chicago area, according to WRAL.
Community leaders expressed gratitude for the prevention, and residents remained cautious, according to WRAL.
No charges have been filed yet, and the investigation continues, according to WRAL.
Authorities prevented the plot before it could be executed, according to NBC 5 Chicago.
body: NBC 5 Chicago reported that two suburban Taco Bell employees helped foil an alleged mass shooting plot. The employees reported suspicious activity to authorities, and the plan was prevented. The report said the employees were key in alerting law enforcement.

WRAL said the Chicago-area Hindu community was shaken but resilient after the alleged plan was thwarted. Community leaders expressed gratitude for the prevention, and residents remained cautious. The report noted that no charges have been filed yet.

WRAL reported that the alleged plot aimed at a Hindu community in the Chicago area. Authorities have not released further details, and the investigation continues. The incident was prevented before it could be executed, according to NBC 5 Chicago.
en.context: An alleged mass shooting plot was reported in the Chicago area. Local news outlets covered the incident, noting that two Taco Bell employees reported suspicious activity. The plot was said to target a Hindu community, and authorities prevented it before it could be carried out.

problemsFixed: Unsupported claim that the plot targeted a Hindu community attributed to NBC 5 Chicago
Short declarative sentences in a row
No explicit attribution for the claim that no charges have been filed
